Here is a simple example of how you could write this rule in YAML format for Semgrep:

```yaml
---
id: vun-url-to-png-e4eaeca6
title: Unsafe URL to PNG conversion
description: This rule detects when the application converts an unsafe user input (URL) directly into a file name.
severity: WARNING
language: typescript
file: '**/*.ts'
context:
  function: handleExtractQueryParamsMiddleware
  args:
    - encryptionService
pattern: |-
  :[identifier]function handleExtractQueryParamsMiddleware(encryptionService?): async (c: Context<AppEnv>, next: () => Promise<void>) => {
  }
---
```

This rule will match any function named `handleExtractQueryParamsMiddleware` in TypeScript files. The pattern is a simple regex that matches the function signature, but it's important to note that this is a very basic example and might not cover all possible variations of the function.

The id should be unique for each rule, so you can use any UUID-like string as long as it's descriptive enough. The title and description are human-readable labels for the rule.

Finally, the severity field is used to indicate how severe a finding of this rule would be. It should be one of ERROR, WARNING or INFO.
